text: And they brought his shirt, with false blood on it.
They both raced to the door. She grabbed him... and tore his shirt from the back.
They looked. The shirt was torn from the back.
His second shirt. The first one told a lie about him. This one told the truth.
Then he gave them his shirt. "Take this shirt of mine and cast it over the face of my father. He will see again. And bring me all your family."
When the bearer of good news arrived, he cast the shirt over his face... and he could see again.
His third shirt. The first carried a lie. The second carried the truth. This one would carry healing.
